target_claims.statement: The classical Hodge conjecture is rational cycle-class surjectivity for smooth projective complex varieties.
Cycle-class surjectivity is equivalent to rational generation by irreducible codimension-p subvariety classes.
The cases p=0,1,n-1,n imply the full conjecture in complex dimension at most three.

inputs: Exact Hodge claim records and proof-obligation DAG.
Semantic mutation fixtures for coefficient, geometry, quantifier, and implication drift.
checker_contract.acceptance: Accept only exact statement identity and the scoped package proofs with every imported theorem visible.
checker_contract.rejection: Reject substitution of integral, compact-Kahler, arbitrary complex (p,p), effective-cycle, or universal claims.

claim_boundary: Statement consistency and low-dimensional package arguments do not prove the full Hodge conjecture or select a new restricted target.
reopening_conditions: Reopen when the normalized statement, package proof, imported-theorem boundary, or MATHCERT disposition changes.
